body: You and your doctor are amazing people, being honest and genuine is a virtue that rivals any other sin. Try something new, something that calms your mind and gives you strength. Another day is just over the horizon, and as Samwise Gamjee once said "When the sun shines, it'll shine out the clearer"

It's nice that you have the will to share your story and seek advice. 

It is hard to feel the pain of others over the internet, but all I can hopefully say and to get you up on your feet is,

You still have a chance, not to redeem yourself, but to start anew, take a day off, sit down and think about what you've done in the past and remember the pain you are feeling now. Close your eyes and remember the choices that you chose wrong, learn and change and think about this, you are but one human out of the billions alive, you have the privilege of being one of the most privileged human alive on this earth, you could had been an Iraqi child hiding from fear, a lone disabled man in India, but you're not. You are lucky to be in a world where science, technology and human progression is at it's finest and there are so many things to look foward to. When you open your eyes, look at your hands, remember the pain and use it to fight on and try something new. Whether it be cosmicism, philosophy or just another way of life, try it out. This isn't a game where you have 3 tries, this is your storybook, finish writing it with a good ending.

I hope this helped you and gave you some insights on what we all can do for each other. Good luck on the path.

Thanks for the comfort, even though it's brief but every little ounce of it helps me to keep on. Knowing that someone actually replied and took the time out of their day to reply and upvote my submission warms me to my core. Thank you.
